propositions: Validation logic is sometimes implemented only in CLI commands while library/MCP/reconciler paths skip it, creating an enforcement gap.
A new ADVISORY plan-review criterion project.engine-layer-enforcement should trigger deterministically when plan file_impact touches CLI command or interface modules.
The criterion should detect validation/guard/check work placed in interface layers and flag CLI-only placement, recommending engine-layer enforcement.
Registry routing and criterion definition must be added to .rebar/criteria_routing.json and reflected in the generated plan-review-criteria-guide.
Behavioral evaluation must demonstrate the criterion fires for CLI-only validation patterns and remains silent for engine-delegated patterns.
rebar explain project.engine-layer-enforcement must render the criterion definition and rationale.
